instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct spelling of the word.

atoms.b: We will ((++build bild biuld builed)) a tower.
The ((++early erly earlee earlley)) bird catches the worm.
atoms.finishSound: The early bird catches the worm.

atoms.b: I would like to ((++learn lern learne lerrn)) German.
atoms.finishSound: I would like to learn German

atoms.b: An apple is a ((++fruit fruut fwuit fruite)).
The queen has had a long ((++reign rain raine reigne)).
atoms.finishSound: The queen has had a long reign.

atoms.b: We lined up as a ((++group groop groupe groap)).
atoms.finishSound: We lined up as a group.

atoms.b: The ((++guide gide guied gyide)) took us on a tour.
atoms.finishSound: the guide took us on a tour
